summary: Completed frontend testing of Debt Follow-up feature (متابعة الذمم) with WhatsApp preview/edit functionality. All core features working correctly: route /debts-followup loads, page displays debt summaries and aging, WhatsApp preview dialog allows message editing before sending, bulk selection and bulk send work, Customers and Suppliers pages have WhatsApp preview buttons in expanded cards.

issues: Finance section (المالية والمحاسبة) is collapsed by default - user needs to click to expand and see debt followup link. This is expected behavior but worth noting for UX.
